## Crosstables

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(janitor)

# --- 1) Start from your subset (adds types you wanted) ---
bdnf_subset <- bdnf %>%
  select(ID, Standort, Zeitpunkt, Gruppe, Sex, Age_start, CogTel,
         CpG_position, rauchen, methylierung) %>%
  mutate(
    ID            = as.factor(ID),
    Standort      = as.factor(Standort),
    Zeitpunkt     = as.factor(Zeitpunkt),
    Gruppe        = as.factor(Gruppe),
    Sex           = as.factor(Sex),
    CpG_position  = as.factor(CpG_position),
    CogTel        = as.numeric(CogTel),
    rauchen       = as.factor(rauchen),
    methylierung  = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(methylierung))
  )
```

```{r}
bdnf_subset %>% tabyl(Standort, Zeitpunkt) %>% adorn_totals(c("row","col"))

```
```{r}
#| message: false
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(purrr)
library(flextable)

# ---------- helpers ----------
first_non_na <- function(x) { y <- x[!is.na(x)]; if (length(y)) y[1] else NA }

fmt_cell <- function(x) {
  x <- x[!is.na(x)]
  n <- length(x)
  if (n == 0) return("—")
  sprintf("%.2f (%.2f)\n(n=%d)", mean(x), sd(x), n)
}

fmt_p <- function(p) {
  if (is.na(p)) return("n/a")
  if (p < 0.001) return("<0.001")
  sprintf("%.3f", p)
}

p_rows_for_var <- function(df, var, z_levels) {
  purrr::map_dfr(z_levels, function(z) {
    d <- df %>% dplyr::filter(Zeitpunkt == z, !is.na(.data[[var]]), !is.na(methylierung))
    if (nrow(d) == 0) return(data.frame(Variable = var, Level = "p-value", Zeitpunkt = z, Stat = "n/a"))

    groups <- split(d$methylierung, d[[var]])
    groups <- groups[lengths(groups) > 0]
    k <- length(groups)

    if (k < 2) {
      pv <- NA_real_
    } else if (k == 2) {
      if (all(lengths(groups) >= 2)) {
        pv <- suppressWarnings(stats::wilcox.test(groups[[1]], groups[[2]], exact = FALSE)$p.value)
      } else {
        pv <- NA_real_
      }
    } else {
      if (sum(lengths(groups) >= 2) >= 2) {
        pv <- stats::kruskal.test(x = d$methylierung, g = as.factor(d[[var]]))$p.value
      } else {
        pv <- NA_real_
      }
    }
    data.frame(Variable = var, Level = "p-value", Zeitpunkt = z, Stat = paste0("p=", fmt_p(pv)))
  })
}

# ---------- 1) Subject × Zeitpunkt summary (avg across CpGs) ----------
maybe_levels <- c("T0","T1","T2")
z_levels <- intersect(maybe_levels, unique(as.character(bdnf_subset$Zeitpunkt)))
if (length(z_levels) == 0) z_levels <- unique(as.character(bdnf_subset$Zeitpunkt))

sub_tp <- bdnf_subset %>%
  mutate(Zeitpunkt = factor(as.character(Zeitpunkt), levels = z_levels)) %>%
  group_by(ID, Zeitpunkt) %>%
  summarise(
    methylierung = mean(methylierung, na.rm = TRUE),
    Standort = first_non_na(Standort),
    Gruppe   = first_non_na(Gruppe),
    Sex      = first_non_na(Sex),
    rauchen  = first_non_na(rauchen),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# ---------- 2) Build rows (levels) + p-value rows ----------
row_vars <- intersect(c("Standort","Gruppe","Sex","rauchen"), names(sub_tp))

# Level summaries
long_levels <- purrr::map_dfr(row_vars, function(v) {
  sub_tp %>%
    filter(!is.na(.data[[v]])) %>%
    group_by(Variable = v, Level = as.character(.data[[v]]), Zeitpunkt) %>%
    summarise(Stat = fmt_cell(methylierung), .groups = "drop")
})

# P-value rows (per Zeitpunkt)
long_p <- purrr::map_dfr(row_vars, ~ p_rows_for_var(sub_tp, .x, z_levels))

# Combine and mark p rows
long_all <- bind_rows(long_levels, long_p) %>%
  mutate(is_p = (Level == "p-value"))

# ---------- 3) Wide table: Zeitpunkt as columns ----------
xtab <- long_all %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = Zeitpunkt, values_from = Stat) %>%
  { missing_cols <- setdiff(z_levels, names(.));
    for (cc in missing_cols) .[[cc]] <- NA_character_;
    .
  } %>%
  arrange(Variable, is_p, Level) %>%
  select(Variable, Level, all_of(z_levels))   # drop is_p after sorting

# ---------- 4) Flextable ----------
ft <- flextable(xtab) |>
  set_caption(
    "Methylierung mean (SD), n by category (rows) and Zeitpunkt (columns).
     p-values compare category levels within each Zeitpunkt (Wilcoxon for 2; Kruskal–Wallis for ≥3)."
  ) |>
  merge_v(j = "Variable") |>
  valign(j = "Variable", valign = "top") |>
  theme_booktabs() |>
  autofit() |>
  align(align = "center", part = "all")

ft

```

```{r}
# --- TAU crosstable: Zeit as columns, rows = categories; value = methylation
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(purrr)
library(flextable)

# Standardize names if needed
if ("Rauchen" %in% names(tau) && !"rauchen" %in% names(tau)) {
  tau <- dplyr::rename(tau, rauchen = Rauchen)
}
if ("Methylation" %in% names(tau) && !"methylation" %in% names(tau)) {
  tau <- dplyr::rename(tau, methylation = Methylation)
}

safe_first <- function(x) {
  x2 <- x[!is.na(x)]
  if (length(x2) == 0) return(NA)
  dplyr::first(x2)
}
fmt_cell <- function(x) {
  x <- x[!is.na(x)]; n <- length(x)
  if (n == 0) return("—")
  sprintf("%.2f (%.2f)\n(n=%d)", mean(x), sd(x), n)
}
fmt_p <- function(p) ifelse(is.na(p), "n/a", ifelse(p < 0.001, "<0.001", sprintf("%.3f", p)))

# Keep only needed columns & coerce types
need <- intersect(c("ID","standort_aus_andere_quelle","Zeit","Gruppe","Sex","rauchen","methylation"), names(tau))
dat  <- tau[, need, drop = FALSE] %>%
  mutate(
    ID = as.factor(ID),
    across(c(standort_aus_andere_quelle, Gruppe, Sex, rauchen), ~ if (is.null(.x)) NULL else as.factor(.x)),
    Zeit         = as.factor(Zeit),
    methylation  = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(methylation))
  )

# Order timepoints
maybe_levels <- c("T0","T1","T2")
z_levels <- intersect(maybe_levels, unique(as.character(dat$Zeit)))
if (length(z_levels) == 0) z_levels <- unique(as.character(dat$Zeit))
dat <- dat %>% mutate(Zeit = factor(as.character(Zeit), levels = z_levels))

# Subject × Zeit: average across repeats
sub_tp <- dat %>%
  group_by(ID, Zeit) %>%
  summarise(
    value   = mean(methylation, na.rm = TRUE),
    Standort = safe_first(standort_aus_andere_quelle),
    Gruppe   = safe_first(Gruppe),
    Sex      = safe_first(Sex),
    rauchen  = safe_first(rauchen),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

row_vars <- intersect(c("standort_aus_andere_quelle","Gruppe","Sex","rauchen"), names(sub_tp))
if (length(row_vars) == 0) stop("No categorical variables among: standort_aus_andere_quelle, Gruppe, Sex, rauchen")

# p-values per variable per Zeit
p_rows_for_var <- function(df_sub, var, z_levels) {
  purrr::map_dfr(z_levels, function(z) {
    d <- df_sub %>% filter(Zeit == z, !is.na(.data[[var]]), !is.na(value))
    if (nrow(d) == 0) return(tibble(Variable = var, Level = "p-value", Zeit = z, Stat = "n/a"))
    groups <- split(d$value, d[[var]]); groups <- groups[lengths(groups) > 0]
    k <- length(groups)
    if (k < 2) {
      pv <- NA_real_
    } else if (k == 2) {
      pv <- tryCatch(suppressWarnings(wilcox.test(groups[[1]], groups[[2]], exact = FALSE)$p.value),
                     error = function(e) NA_real_)
    } else {
      pv <- tryCatch(kruskal.test(x = d$value, g = as.factor(d[[var]]))$p.value,
                     error = function(e) NA_real_)
    }
    tibble(Variable = var, Level = "p-value", Zeit = z, Stat = paste0("p=", fmt_p(pv)))
  })
}

# Level summaries
long_levels <- purrr::map_dfr(row_vars, function(v) {
  sub_tp %>%
    filter(!is.na(.data[[v]])) %>%
    group_by(Variable = v, Level = as.character(.data[[v]]), Zeit) %>%
    summarise(Stat = fmt_cell(value), .groups = "drop")
})
long_p <- purrr::map_dfr(row_vars, ~ p_rows_for_var(sub_tp, .x, z_levels))

long_all <- bind_rows(long_levels, long_p) %>% mutate(is_p = (Level == "p-value"))

xtab <- long_all %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Zeit, values_from = Stat) %>%
  { missing <- setdiff(z_levels, names(.)); for (cc in missing) .[[cc]] <- NA_character_; . } %>%
  arrange(Variable, is_p, Level) %>%
  select(Variable, Level, all_of(z_levels))  # drop is_p after sort

ft <- flextable(xtab) |>
  set_caption("TAU — methylation: mean (SD), n by category (rows) and Zeit (columns); p-values per Zeit.") |>
  merge_v(j = "Variable") |>
  valign(j = "Variable", valign = "top") |>
  theme_booktabs() |>
  autofit() |>
  align(align = "center", part = "all")

print(ft)

```


```{r}
# --- PSD95 crosstable: Zeitpunkt as columns, rows = categories; value = methylation
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(purrr)
library(flextable)

# If needed, standardize column names
if ("Rauchen" %in% names(psd95) && !"rauchen" %in% names(psd95)) {
  psd95 <- dplyr::rename(psd95, rauchen = Rauchen)
}
if ("Methylation" %in% names(psd95) && !"methylation" %in% names(psd95)) {
  psd95 <- dplyr::rename(psd95, methylation = Methylation)
}

safe_first <- function(x) {
  x2 <- x[!is.na(x)]
  if (length(x2) == 0) return(NA)
  dplyr::first(x2)
}
fmt_cell <- function(x) {
  x <- x[!is.na(x)]; n <- length(x)
  if (n == 0) return("—")
  sprintf("%.2f (%.2f)\n(n=%d)", mean(x), sd(x), n)
}
fmt_p <- function(p) ifelse(is.na(p), "n/a", ifelse(p < 0.001, "<0.001", sprintf("%.3f", p)))

# Keep only needed columns & coerce types
need <- intersect(c("ID","standort_aus_andere_quelle","Zeitpunkt","Gruppe","Sex","rauchen","methylation"), names(psd95))
dat  <- psd95[, need, drop = FALSE] %>%
  mutate(
    ID = as.factor(ID),
    across(c(standort_aus_andere_quelle, Gruppe, Sex, rauchen), ~ if (is.null(.x)) NULL else as.factor(.x)),
    Zeitpunkt   = as.factor(Zeitpunkt),
    methylation = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(methylation))
  )

# Order timepoints (T0, T1, T2 if present; else observed order)
maybe_levels <- c("T0","T1","T2")
z_levels <- intersect(maybe_levels, unique(as.character(dat$Zeitpunkt)))
if (length(z_levels) == 0) z_levels <- unique(as.character(dat$Zeitpunkt))
dat <- dat %>% mutate(Zeitpunkt = factor(as.character(Zeitpunkt), levels = z_levels))

# Subject × Zeitpunkt: average across repeats (e.g., CpGs)
sub_tp <- dat %>%
  group_by(ID, Zeitpunkt) %>%
  summarise(
    value   = mean(methylation, na.rm = TRUE),
    Standort = safe_first(standort_aus_andere_quelle),
    Gruppe   = safe_first(Gruppe),
    Sex      = safe_first(Sex),
    rauchen  = safe_first(rauchen),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

row_vars <- intersect(c("Standort","Gruppe","Sex","rauchen"), names(sub_tp))
if (length(row_vars) == 0) stop("No categorical variables among: Standort, Gruppe, Sex, rauchen")

# p-values per variable per Zeitpunkt
p_rows_for_var <- function(df_sub, var, z_levels) {
  purrr::map_dfr(z_levels, function(z) {
    d <- df_sub %>% filter(Zeitpunkt == z, !is.na(.data[[var]]), !is.na(value))
    if (nrow(d) == 0) return(tibble(Variable = var, Level = "p-value", Zeitpunkt = z, Stat = "n/a"))
    groups <- split(d$value, d[[var]]); groups <- groups[lengths(groups) > 0]
    k <- length(groups)
    if (k < 2) {
      pv <- NA_real_
    } else if (k == 2) {
      pv <- tryCatch(suppressWarnings(wilcox.test(groups[[1]], groups[[2]], exact = FALSE)$p.value),
                     error = function(e) NA_real_)
    } else {
      pv <- tryCatch(kruskal.test(x = d$value, g = as.factor(d[[var]]))$p.value,
                     error = function(e) NA_real_)
    }
    tibble(Variable = var, Level = "p-value", Zeitpunkt = z, Stat = paste0("p=", fmt_p(pv)))
  })
}

# Level summaries
long_levels <- purrr::map_dfr(row_vars, function(v) {
  sub_tp %>%
    filter(!is.na(.data[[v]])) %>%
    group_by(Variable = v, Level = as.character(.data[[v]]), Zeitpunkt) %>%
    summarise(Stat = fmt_cell(value), .groups = "drop")
})
long_p <- purrr::map_dfr(row_vars, ~ p_rows_for_var(sub_tp, .x, z_levels))

long_all <- bind_rows(long_levels, long_p) %>% mutate(is_p = (Level == "p-value"))

xtab <- long_all %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Zeitpunkt, values_from = Stat) %>%
  { missing <- setdiff(z_levels, names(.)); for (cc in missing) .[[cc]] <- NA_character_; . } %>%
  arrange(Variable, is_p, Level) %>%
  select(Variable, Level, all_of(z_levels))  # drop is_p after sort

ft <- flextable(xtab) |>
  set_caption("PSD95 — methylation: mean (SD), n by category (rows) and Zeitpunkt (columns); p-values per Zeitpunkt.") |>
  merge_v(j = "Variable") |>
  valign(j = "Variable", valign = "top") |>
  theme_booktabs() |>
  autofit() |>
  align(align = "center", part = "all")

print(ft)

```

## BDNF — use only m148, m066, m111, m058 (time = Zeitpunkt, value = methylierung)

```{r}
# --- BDNF crosstable (Zeitpunkt as columns), filtered CpGs: m148,m066,m111,m058
library(dplyr); library(tidyr); library(purrr); library(flextable)

# ---- config ----
cpg_keep <- c("m148","m066","m111","m058")

# ---- helpers ----
safe_first <- function(x){ x2 <- x[!is.na(x)]; if (!length(x2)) return(NA); dplyr::first(x2) }
fmt_cell <- function(x){ x <- x[!is.na(x)]; n <- length(x); if(!n) return("—"); sprintf("%.2f (%.2f)\n(n=%d)", mean(x), sd(x), n) }
fmt_p <- function(p){ if(is.na(p)) "n/a" else if(p < 0.001) "<0.001" else sprintf("%.3f", p) }

# Standardize names
bdnf2 <- bdnf
if ("Rauchen" %in% names(bdnf2) && !"rauchen" %in% names(bdnf2)) bdnf2 <- rename(bdnf2, rauchen = Rauchen)
if ("standort_aus_andere_quelle" %in% names(bdnf2) && !"Standort" %in% names(bdnf2)) bdnf2 <- rename(bdnf2, Standort = standort_aus_andere_quelle)

# Detect CpG column
cp_candidates <- c("CpG","CpG_position","cpg","CpG_Site","cpg_position")
cp_col <- cp_candidates[cp_candidates %in% names(bdnf2)][1]
if (is.na(cp_col)) stop("No CpG column found. Tried: ", paste(cp_candidates, collapse=", "))

# Keep required columns, coerce types, filter CpGs
need <- intersect(c("ID","Standort","Zeitpunkt","Gruppe","Sex","rauchen","methylierung", cp_col), names(bdnf2))
dat <- bdnf2[, need, drop = FALSE] %>%
  rename(CpG = all_of(cp_col)) %>%
  filter(as.character(CpG) %in% cpg_keep) %>%
  mutate(
    ID = as.factor(ID),
    across(c(Standort, Gruppe, Sex, rauchen), ~ if (!is.null(.x)) as.factor(.x) else .x),
    Zeitpunkt    = as.factor(Zeitpunkt),
    methylierung = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(methylierung))
  )

# Order timepoints
maybe_levels <- c("T0","T1","T2")
z_levels <- intersect(maybe_levels, unique(as.character(dat$Zeitpunkt)))
if (!length(z_levels)) z_levels <- unique(as.character(dat$Zeitpunkt))
dat <- mutate(dat, Zeitpunkt = factor(as.character(Zeitpunkt), levels = z_levels))

# Subject × Zeitpunkt: mean over selected CpGs (and any repeats)
sub_tp <- dat %>%
  group_by(ID, Zeitpunkt) %>%
  summarise(
    value   = mean(methylierung, na.rm = TRUE),
    Standort = safe_first(Standort),
    Gruppe   = safe_first(Gruppe),
    Sex      = safe_first(Sex),
    rauchen  = safe_first(rauchen),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

row_vars <- intersect(c("Standort","Gruppe","Sex","rauchen"), names(sub_tp))
if (!length(row_vars)) stop("No categorical variables among: Standort, Gruppe, Sex, rauchen")

# p-values per variable per Zeitpunkt
p_rows_for_var <- function(df_sub, var, z_lv){
  map_dfr(z_lv, function(z){
    d <- df_sub %>% filter(Zeitpunkt == z, !is.na(.data[[var]]), !is.na(value))
    if (!nrow(d)) return(tibble(Variable=var, Level="p-value", Zeitpunkt=z, Stat="n/a"))
    groups <- split(d$value, d[[var]]); groups <- groups[lengths(groups)>0]; k <- length(groups)
    pv <- if (k<2) NA_real_ else if (k==2)
      tryCatch(suppressWarnings(wilcox.test(groups[[1]], groups[[2]], exact=FALSE)$p.value), error=function(e) NA_real_)
    else
      tryCatch(kruskal.test(x=d$value, g=as.factor(d[[var]]))$p.value, error=function(e) NA_real_)
    tibble(Variable=var, Level="p-value", Zeitpunkt=z, Stat=paste0("p=", fmt_p(pv)))
  })
}

# Level summaries + p rows
long_levels <- map_dfr(row_vars, \(v) sub_tp %>%
  filter(!is.na(.data[[v]])) %>%
  group_by(Variable=v, Level=as.character(.data[[v]]), Zeitpunkt) %>%
  summarise(Stat=fmt_cell(value), .groups="drop"))

long_p <- map_dfr(row_vars, ~ p_rows_for_var(sub_tp, .x, z_levels))
long_all <- bind_rows(long_levels, long_p) %>% mutate(is_p = Level=="p-value")

xtab <- long_all %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from=Zeitpunkt, values_from=Stat) %>%
  { missing <- setdiff(z_levels, names(.)); for (cc in missing) .[[cc]] <- NA_character_; . } %>%
  arrange(Variable, is_p, Level) %>%
  select(Variable, Level, all_of(z_levels))

ft <- flextable(xtab) |>
  set_caption(paste0("BDNF — filtered CpGs: ", paste(cpg_keep, collapse=", "),
                     " — methylierung mean (SD), n by category (rows) and Zeitpunkt (columns); p-values per Zeitpunkt.")) |>
  merge_v(j="Variable") |>
  valign(j="Variable", valign="top") |>
  theme_booktabs() |>
  autofit() |>
  align(align="center", part="all")

print(ft)

```
## TAU — use only m331, m337, m310, m315, m323 (time = Zeit, value = methylation)
```{r}
# --- TAU crosstable (Zeit as columns), filtered CpGs: m331,m337,m310, m315, m323
library(dplyr); library(tidyr); library(purrr); library(flextable)

cpg_keep <- c("m331","m337","m310","m315","m323")

safe_first <- function(x){ x2 <- x[!is.na(x)]; if (!length(x2)) return(NA); dplyr::first(x2) }
fmt_cell <- function(x){ x <- x[!is.na(x)]; n <- length(x); if(!n) return("—"); sprintf("%.2f (%.2f)\n(n=%d)", mean(x), sd(x), n) }
fmt_p <- function(p){ if(is.na(p)) "n/a" else if(p < 0.001) "<0.001" else sprintf("%.3f", p) }

tau2 <- tau
if ("Rauchen" %in% names(tau2) && !"rauchen" %in% names(tau2)) tau2 <- rename(tau2, rauchen = Rauchen)
if ("Methylation" %in% names(tau2) && !"methylation" %in% names(tau2)) tau2 <- rename(tau2, methylation = Methylation)
if ("standort_aus_andere_quelle" %in% names(tau2) && !"Standort" %in% names(tau2)) tau2 <- rename(tau2, Standort = standort_aus_andere_quelle)

cp_candidates <- c("CpG","CpG_position","cpg","CpG_Site","cpg_position")
cp_col <- cp_candidates[cp_candidates %in% names(tau2)][1]
if (is.na(cp_col)) stop("No CpG column found in tau. Tried: ", paste(cp_candidates, collapse=", "))

need <- intersect(c("ID","Standort","Zeit","Gruppe","Sex","rauchen","methylation", cp_col), names(tau2))
dat <- tau2[, need, drop = FALSE] %>%
  rename(CpG = all_of(cp_col)) %>%
  filter(as.character(CpG) %in% cpg_keep) %>%
  mutate(
    ID = as.factor(ID),
    across(c(Standort, Gruppe, Sex, rauchen), ~ if (!is.null(.x)) as.factor(.x) else .x),
    Zeit        = as.factor(Zeit),
    methylation = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(methylation))
  )

maybe_levels <- c("T0","T1","T2")
z_levels <- intersect(maybe_levels, unique(as.character(dat$Zeit)))
if (!length(z_levels)) z_levels <- unique(as.character(dat$Zeit))
dat <- mutate(dat, Zeit = factor(as.character(Zeit), levels = z_levels))

sub_tp <- dat %>%
  group_by(ID, Zeit) %>%
  summarise(
    value   = mean(methylation, na.rm = TRUE),
    Standort = safe_first(Standort),
    Gruppe   = safe_first(Gruppe),
    Sex      = safe_first(Sex),
    rauchen  = safe_first(rauchen),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

row_vars <- intersect(c("Standort","Gruppe","Sex","rauchen"), names(sub_tp))
if (!length(row_vars)) stop("No categorical variables among: Standort, Gruppe, Sex, rauchen")

p_rows_for_var <- function(df_sub, var, z_lv){
  map_dfr(z_lv, function(z){
    d <- df_sub %>% filter(Zeit == z, !is.na(.data[[var]]), !is.na(value))
    if (!nrow(d)) return(tibble(Variable=var, Level="p-value", Zeit=z, Stat="n/a"))
    groups <- split(d$value, d[[var]]); groups <- groups[lengths(groups)>0]; k <- length(groups)
    pv <- if (k<2) NA_real_ else if (k==2)
      tryCatch(suppressWarnings(wilcox.test(groups[[1]], groups[[2]], exact=FALSE)$p.value), error=function(e) NA_real_)
    else
      tryCatch(kruskal.test(x=d$value, g=as.factor(d[[var]]))$p.value, error=function(e) NA_real_)
    tibble(Variable=var, Level="p-value", Zeit=z, Stat=paste0("p=", fmt_p(pv)))
  })
}

long_levels <- map_dfr(row_vars, \(v) sub_tp %>%
  filter(!is.na(.data[[v]])) %>%
  group_by(Variable=v, Level=as.character(.data[[v]]), Zeit) %>%
  summarise(Stat=fmt_cell(value), .groups="drop"))

long_p <- map_dfr(row_vars, ~ p_rows_for_var(sub_tp, .x, z_levels))
long_all <- bind_rows(long_levels, long_p) %>% mutate(is_p = Level=="p-value")

xtab <- long_all %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from=Zeit, values_from=Stat) %>%
  { missing <- setdiff(z_levels, names(.)); for (cc in missing) .[[cc]] <- NA_character_; . } %>%
  arrange(Variable, is_p, Level) %>%
  select(Variable, Level, all_of(z_levels))

ft <- flextable(xtab) |>
  set_caption(paste0("TAU — filtered CpGs: ", paste(cpg_keep, collapse=", "),
                     " — methylation mean (SD), n by category (rows) and Zeit (columns); p-values per Zeit.")) |>
  merge_v(j="Variable") |>
  valign(j="Variable", valign="top") |>
  theme_booktabs() |>
  autofit() |>
  align(align="center", part="all")

print(ft)

```

## PSD95 — use only p95, p60, p23 (time = Zeitpunkt, value = methylation)
```{r}
# --- PSD95 crosstable (Zeitpunkt as columns) using CpG_Position; keep p95, p60, p23
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(purrr)
library(flextable)

# Keep these CpGs only
cpg_keep <- c("p95","p60","p23")
cp_col   <- "CpG_Position"

# Helpers
safe_first <- function(x){ x2 <- x[!is.na(x)]; if (!length(x2)) return(NA); dplyr::first(x2) }
fmt_cell  <- function(x){ x <- x[!is.na(x)]; n <- length(x); if(!n) return("—"); sprintf("%.2f (%.2f)\n(n=%d)", mean(x), sd(x), n) }
fmt_p     <- function(p){ if(is.na(p)) "n/a" else if(p < 0.001) "<0.001" else sprintf("%.3f", p) }

# Standardize column names we rely on
psd95_2 <- psd95
if ("Rauchen" %in% names(psd95_2) && !"rauchen" %in% names(psd95_2)) psd95_2 <- dplyr::rename(psd95_2, rauchen = Rauchen)
if ("Methylation" %in% names(psd95_2) && !"methylation" %in% names(psd95_2)) psd95_2 <- dplyr::rename(psd95_2, methylation = Methylation)
if ("standort_aus_andere_quelle" %in% names(psd95_2) && !"Standort" %in% names(psd95_2)) psd95_2 <- dplyr::rename(psd95_2, Standort = standort_aus_andere_quelle)

# Keep only needed columns and filter CpGs
need <- intersect(c("ID","Standort","Zeitpunkt","Gruppe","Sex","rauchen","methylation", cp_col), names(psd95_2))
dat  <- psd95_2[, need, drop = FALSE] %>%
  dplyr::rename(CpG = all_of(cp_col)) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(CpG = as.character(CpG)) %>%
  dplyr::filter(tolower(CpG) %in% tolower(cpg_keep)) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    ID = as.factor(ID),
    across(c(Standort, Gruppe, Sex, rauchen), ~ as.factor(.x)),
    Zeitpunkt   = factor(as.character(Zeitpunkt)),
    methylation = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(methylation))
  )

# Order timepoints T0/T1/T2 if present; else observed order
maybe_levels <- c("T0","T1","T2")
z_levels <- intersect(maybe_levels, levels(dat$Zeitpunkt))
if (length(z_levels) == 0) z_levels <- levels(dat$Zeitpunkt)
dat$Zeitpunkt <- factor(dat$Zeitpunkt, levels = z_levels)

# Subject × Zeitpunkt: average across selected CpGs
sub_tp <- dat %>%
  dplyr::group_by(ID, Zeitpunkt) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    value    = mean(methylation, na.rm = TRUE),
    Standort = safe_first(Standort),
    Gruppe   = safe_first(Gruppe),
    Sex      = safe_first(Sex),
    rauchen  = safe_first(rauchen),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

row_vars <- intersect(c("Standort","Gruppe","Sex","rauchen"), names(sub_tp))
stopifnot(length(row_vars) > 0)

# P-values per variable per Zeitpunkt
p_rows_for_var <- function(df_sub, var, z_lv){
  purrr::map_dfr(z_lv, function(z){
    d <- df_sub %>% dplyr::filter(Zeitpunkt == z, !is.na(.data[[var]]), !is.na(value))
    if (!nrow(d)) return(tibble(Variable=var, Level="p-value", Zeitpunkt=z, Stat="n/a"))
    groups <- split(d$value, d[[var]]); groups <- groups[lengths(groups)>0]; k <- length(groups)
    pv <- if (k<2) NA_real_ else if (k==2)
      tryCatch(suppressWarnings(wilcox.test(groups[[1]], groups[[2]], exact=FALSE)$p.value), error=function(e) NA_real_)
    else
      tryCatch(kruskal.test(x=d$value, g=as.factor(d[[var]]))$p.value, error=function(e) NA_real_)
    tibble(Variable=var, Level="p-value", Zeitpunkt=z, Stat=paste0("p=", fmt_p(pv)))
  })
}

# Level summaries + p rows
long_levels <- purrr::map_dfr(row_vars, function(v){
  sub_tp %>%
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(.data[[v]])) %>%
    dplyr::group_by(Variable = v, Level = as.character(.data[[v]]), Zeitpunkt) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(Stat = fmt_cell(value), .groups = "drop")
})
long_p   <- purrr::map_dfr(row_vars, ~ p_rows_for_var(sub_tp, .x, z_levels))
long_all <- dplyr::bind_rows(long_levels, long_p) %>% dplyr::mutate(is_p = (Level == "p-value"))

# Wider, ensure all timepoint columns exist, sort rows
xtab <- long_all %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = Zeitpunkt, values_from = Stat)
missing_cols <- setdiff(z_levels, names(xtab))
if (length(missing_cols) > 0) for (cc in missing_cols) xtab[[cc]] <- NA_character_
xtab <- xtab %>% dplyr::arrange(Variable, is_p, Level) %>% dplyr::select(Variable, Level, all_of(z_levels))

# Flextable
ft <- flextable(xtab) |>
  set_caption(paste0(
    "PSD95 — CpG_Position filtered to: ", paste(cpg_keep, collapse=", "),
    " — methylation mean (SD), n by category (rows) and Zeitpunkt (columns); p-values per Zeitpunkt."
  )) |>
  merge_v(j = "Variable") |>
  valign(j = "Variable", valign = "top") |>
  theme_booktabs() |>
  autofit() |>
  align(align = "center", part = "all")

print(ft)

```
